Title: Cortexa saved repository collector
Description: As a desktop user, I want to collect code from repositories already saved in Cortexa so that I can analyze projects that colleagues have ingested. The app uses the existing clone endpoints GET {prefix}/files and GET {prefix}/download through the API gateway. Files are cached locally and processed like other sources.
AcceptanceCriteria: Desktop app calls the existing clone /files endpoint to list repository contents
Desktop app calls clone /download endpoint to fetch file contents
All calls go through the API gateway (localhost:5080)
Files are cached in SQLite with Cortexa repository metadata
Source_type is set to cortexa_repo in the batch upload
End-to-end check: all 4 remote sources work and upload with correct source types
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)

Dependencies.Contract: exists:gateway clone /files and /download (called over HTTP, no code reference)

TalkingPoints: Integrating Cortexa saved repository collection via the existing clone API endpoints. Files are fetched through the gateway and cached locally. Completing all four remote sources (GitHub, Azure DevOps, SSH, and Cortexa).

Tasks.Title: Implement Cortexa repository client
Tasks.Description: Call GET {prefix}/files and /download through the API gateway; handle authentication.

Tasks.Title: Cache Cortexa repository files
Tasks.Description: Store files with repository ID, branch, path, and Cortexa metadata in SQLite.

Tasks.Title: Set source_type to cortexa_repo in batch upload
Tasks.Description: When uploading Cortexa-sourced knowledge, set source_type=cortexa_repo.

Tasks.Title: Build Cortexa repository picker UI
Tasks.Description: Show available Cortexa repositories; allow user to select and fetch.

Tasks.Title: Test Cortexa repository collection and end-to-end sources
Tasks.Description: Verify all four sources (local, GitHub, Azure DevOps, SSH, Cortexa) collect and upload with correct source types.

Tests.Title: Cortexa repository files are fetched and cached

Steps.Action: Select a Cortexa repository in the picker
Steps.Expected: GET {prefix}/files is called; file tree is fetched and cached

Tests.Title: End-to-end check covering all four remote sources

Steps.Expected: All services start; gateway on localhost:5080

Steps.Action: Sign in to desktop collector; load a local folder
Steps.Expected: Folder is parsed into units; ready for extraction

Steps.Action: Extract knowledge; upload batch with source_type=local
Steps.Expected: Batch appears in History with source_type=local

Steps.Action: Load a GitHub repository (requires GitHub PAT in settings)
Steps.Expected: Files are fetched; extract knowledge; upload with source_type=github

Steps.Action: Load an Azure DevOps repository (requires Azure DevOps PAT in settings)
Steps.Expected: Files are fetched; extract knowledge; upload with source_type=azure_devops

Steps.Action: Load via SSH (requires host, key file, and fingerprint in settings)
Steps.Expected: Files are fetched; extract knowledge; upload with source_type=ssh
Files are fetched from clone /files and /download; extract knowledge; upload with source_type=cortexa_repo

Steps.Action: Check History; verify all four batches appear with distinct source_type
Steps.Expected: Four batches shown: local, github, azure_devops, ssh, cortexa_repo

Steps.Action: Check Cosmos chunks container; verify four sets of knowledge items with different source types
Steps.Expected: Knowledge items grouped by source_type; each carries correct provenance
